name: lpc-spritesheet-mcp
description: MCP server that generates Universal LPC character spritesheets headlessly (no browser) from the LiberatedPixelCup asset pack: 657 items, 6 body types, palette recoloring, 15 standard animations plus oversize custom ones, animated GIF previews, seeded random characters and NPC batches, curated presets, multi-engine atlases (TexturePacker/Aseprite/Godot/libGDX/Unity), and opt-in AI-assisted design

scripts.assets: npm run diagrams && npm run showcase && npm run demo
scripts.test: node --test test/run-tests.mjs test/mcp-client-test.mjs test/mcp-surface-test.mjs test/golden-test.mjs test/smoke-canvas.mjs test/gif-test.mjs test/random-test.mjs test/presets-test.mjs test/atlas-formats-test.mjs test/url-test.mjs test/ai-test.mjs test/mcp-new-tools-test.mjs
